placements.why: The position's members decide that delivery is bundled per run per person. A person should get one thing to read, not four. The bundle closes with the run, and per-skill delivery with client-side collapsing is rejected because it moves the ordering problem onto the reader. That is a standing theme about delivery shape that future rulings (windows, routing, collapsing) will keep feeding. No existing leaf holds it. Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate is about decisions disappearing in real-time chat, and nothing in these members concerns that. Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning is the nearest relation: it favors structured delivery over noise, so it is linked with 'see' rather than reused.
placements.title: What reaches a person is shaped for the reader, not for the sender
placements.frame: Where in the pipeline is reaction delivery decided, and what does each ruling or rejected alternative say about who carries the burden of ordering and reading?
